newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-DEFENDER MAY FIND KEEPING HIS HAIR IS COSTLY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DEFENDER MAY FIND KEEPING HIS HAIR IS COSTLY.

text.p: A Spanish footballer who took some tablets to stop going bald may find the remedy is a costly one.
Medical staff at Celta Vigo think tablets to prevent hair loss are the most likely cause of the positive drug test by defender Borja Aguirretxu.
"The player explained that he's been taking tablets to stop hair-loss for a year," said Celta doctor Genaro Borras.
Aguirretxu could face a two-year ban after testing positive for the steroid nandrolone after a 2-0 defeat by Valladolid on January 4.
The Spanish soccer federation consider the case to be "sub judice", but expect to release their findings next week.
